recap.text: Shi Maria, in control of Carl's body, summons an empty beaker and drops in a sliver of the toraline root his sponsor sent. She casts Self-Immolation, the fire burns a hole in the floor, and Carl falls into the apartment below. The burning-hot beaker holds bubbling black liquid: ink. She drives the stick from the tattoo kit into Li Jun's eye, dips it in the beaker, and pokes it rapidly into Carl's chest.

Imani uses Carl's Tripper, and Carl feels a searing pain in his chest as lots of traps go off. Katia had mixed toraline yam ink with his blood, and Carl lost six levels when she drew it. The ink is a small barbed-wire symbol round Imani's ankle, and it is permanent. Rosetta's new plan for Donut needs a tattoo, and Edgar's new ink no longer needs the toraline.

beats.headline: Ink from a beaker
beats.text: With Shi Maria in control of Carl's body, an empty beaker he looted on the first floor appears in his hand, and into it goes a small sliver of the toraline root his sponsor sent. She casts Self-Immolation; the fire burns a hole in the floor, and Carl falls into the apartment below. When he picks up the burning hot beaker, it holds a small amount of bubbling black liquid. Ink. Then the stick and poke tattoo kit is in his hands. After the stick goes into Li Jun's eye, it is dipped in the beaker and poked rapidly into Carl's own chest. You will likely be doing more of this soon with the remaining ink, she tells him.
beats.gist: Shi Maria burns through the floor; toraline root becomes ink in a beaker.

beats.headline: Rosetta wants it
beats.text: In the Meadowlark saferoom, Rosetta puts an icy hand on the Bedlam Bride tattoo and asks how much he has left. Of the toraline, and of the ink the spider used to make that tattoo. Carl pulls out a finger-sized slice of the vegetable and the glass container of Shi Maria's ink, still hot to the touch, a few thimblefuls left; Mordecai has more toraline, but not much. Give me access to your saferoom and your bomber's studio, Rosetta says, and three million gold. Better make it four.
beats.gist: Rosetta demands access to Carl's saferoom, the bomber's studio and four million gold for his toraline and ink.

beats.headline: Freely given
beats.text: Katia sets a vial on the table with the ink already mixed. If the blood is freely given, she explains, the potion lets you choose the spell or skill, and it is not permanent for the donor: Li Na lost five levels temporarily. Her brother, whose eye was taken with violence, is another matter. The tattoo itself is permanent, and its size follows the level of what it carries. Making the ink took up a third of the potion, and a level-13 skill takes almost all of the vial, leaving just enough for a small tattoo for Imani.
beats.gist: Katia's ink, made with freely given blood, lets the drinker choose a skill.

beats.headline: Tripper, borrowed
beats.text: Carl feels a searing pain in his chest and gets a notification: Imani has used his Tripper, and lots of traps have just gone off. After his chain dragon they reversed the process: Carl drank the associated potion, picked the spell, and lost six levels when Katia drew his blood, which his bandana covers anyway. Imani's tattoo, toraline yam ink mixed with Carl's blood, is a small barbed-wire symbol round her ankle, and it is permanent. The spell will fade from her, and Carl can re-energize it with the yam potion, except that they have barely any of the vegetable left.
beats.gist: Imani borrows Carl's Tripper through a permanent yam-ink tattoo, setting off traps.

beats.headline: No longer needed
beats.text: Rosetta's new plan for Donut needs a tattoo. Edgar extracted the spell properly, she says, and with some ink tips from Milk they no longer need the toraline. Edgar explains as he prepares the ink: the ink Carl had from the toraline lets one borrow spells and skills temporarily from willing subjects, and take them permanently from unwilling ones. His new ink is similar but not identical. It captures the essence of the fallen crawler in a unique way, and he does not know how it will form.
beats.gist: Edgar drops the toraline and mixes new ink that captures a fallen crawler's essence.
